vignette.story: John is an active member of the "Cosmic Creators Collective," known for its creative fanworks and tight-knit social gatherings. His close friend, Alex, who is not part of the community, has always been curious about John's involvement in these groups. Alex sent John a message on "Galactic Chat," asking about his weekend plans. John checked his personal "Star Scheduler" and saw the details of an upcoming "Cosmic Convergence," a community gathering that includes a costume contest and fanfiction readings. He also found a public fan art exhibition called "Visions of the Universe" happening in the city that weekend, which he thought Alex might find interesting.
vignette.data_type_concrete: Details of an upcoming community gathering that includes a costume contest and fanfiction readings.
